name: apple-mail
description: Fast access to Apple Mail on macOS — millisecond search over the local mail store, read messages, clickable open-in-Mail links, manage flags, create drafts, list attachments, and view threads.
long_description:
Connects Claude to Apple Mail on your Mac. Reads are served from Mail.app's local message store (SQLite Envelope Index + .emlx files) — searching 250k+ messages takes milliseconds instead of tens of seconds. Mail.app stays the sync and auth engine (including iCloud), so no credentials are ever handled. Writes (drafts, flags) go through Mail.app's native scripting interface.

**Features:**
- Millisecond search by text, subject, sender, recipient, date range, flags, and attachments
- Every result includes clickable links that open the email in Mail.app (works from chat via a localhost redirector)
- Read full message bodies (plain text and HTML)
- View email threads / conversations (Mail's own conversation grouping)
- Get the message(s) currently selected in Mail.app's viewer
- List and retrieve attachments
- Browse all mailboxes and accounts
- Create draft emails and threaded replies
- Set, change, or remove email flags

**Requirements:**
- macOS 13 Ventura or later
- Apple Mail running with at least one account
- Full Disk Access for the fast read path — enable "uv" in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Full Disk Access (without it, reads fall back to slower Mail.app scripting)
- Automation permission for writes (macOS prompts automatically on first use)

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get overall mail statistics: total messages, unread count, mailbox count

tools.name: list_mailboxes
tools.description: List all mailboxes/folders across all accounts with message counts

tools.name: search_emails
tools.description: Search emails by text, sender, recipient (To/CC), subject, date range, read/flagged status, and attachments

tools.name: get_email
tools.description: Read a full email with plain-text body, recipients, and metadata

tools.name: get_email_link
tools.description: Get a message:// URL that opens the email directly in Mail.app

tools.name: open_email_in_mail
tools.description: Open an email directly in Mail.app (reliable alternative to message:// links, which chat UIs block)

tools.name: get_selected_emails
tools.description: Return the message(s) currently selected in Mail.app's viewer, with id, subject, sender, mailbox, and message:// link

tools.name: get_email_html
tools.description: Get the HTML body of an email

tools.name: get_thread
tools.description: Get all messages in a conversation thread

tools.name: list_email_attachments
tools.description: List all attachments for a specific email

tools.name: get_email_attachment
tools.description: Retrieve an attachment as base64-encoded data

tools.name: create_email_draft
tools.description: Create a draft email in Mail.app and return a message:// link to open it

tools.name: create_email_reply_draft
tools.description: Reply to an existing email — sets In-Reply-To/References headers so the reply threads correctly in the recipient's client

tools.name: get_email_flag
tools.description: Get the flag status and color for an email

tools.name: set_email_flag
tools.description: Set or remove a color flag on an email (red/orange/yellow/green/blue/purple, or null to remove). Note: gray is read-only due to a Mail.app scripting limitation — use Mail.app's UI to set the gray flag.
